title: Daxia Shou Mu Ren
synopsis:
Ten years ago, after a blood moon lasted three days, monsters, deities, mystic eyes, and ghost stories came in succession. As the mysterious and the uncanny fall upon the human world. Horror and despair roam the land. As humans, should we kneel in submission, wail in tears, or unsheathe our blades? This is a new age, and this age belongs to the transcendent! Opening the gate to the transcendent, Su Bai beholds a new world...

(Source: WeTV)
